items.note: ok the KITCHEN. double-height barrel-vaulted ceiling, a fireplace next to the breakfast table, AND a wine cellar with a tasting room downstairs. 2.3 acres. i can't.
a 1928 bronxville house with a stone wall and a whole perennial garden out front. it's giving storybook!!
bronxville!! five bedrooms, would look SO good with a wreath on the door.
5.5 bathrooms for 5 bedrooms. nobody in this house is ever waiting for a shower.
just hit the market this month. 3,400 sq ft in scarsdale for 1.5, honestly kind of a deal for there??
more bathrooms than bedrooms AGAIN. scarsdale has a thing and i respect it.

items.title: "how i've looked throughout the year"
items.body: a month-by-month photo montage of yourself with that line on screen. it's brand new this week, so expect a lot of these as the year wraps up.

items.title: "don't let a fanatic see this"
items.creator: @sidelinedry.us
items.body: people show a super niche gift idea with a warning like "don't let a hockey mom see this." it's basically a gift guide in disguise, and very good for holiday shopping!!

items.title: 85% of gen z are doing thanksgiving
items.body: YPulse says 85% of 13-24 year olds are celebrating today, and most of them plan to actually cook. happy thanksgiving!!

items.title: the parade and football still win
items.body: live tv, the macy's parade and football, is still a big part of gen z's thanksgiving. some things never change.

items.title: nostalgia is the whole vibe
items.body: YPulse says nostalgia is at the heart of how gen z celebrates. same dishes, same rituals, same family chaos.
